name: session-bridge
description: Inspect, resume, and hand off agent sessions across Codex CLI and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Resume and hand off sessions across Codex and Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Reads Codex rollouts and Claude Code transcripts so you can switch off one tool and pick up in the other with full context: list recent sessions, summarize where one left off, and emit a handoff brief for the other tool.
defaultPrompt: List my recent sessions in this repo and summarize where the last one left off
